purpose: Detect, classify and resolve or preserve contradictions between property records, dates, documents, legal sources, procedural sources and answer components without silently selecting a preferred version.
authority_rules: A later record may supersede an earlier record only where the legal/record framework supports that effect.
A current register entry cannot automatically erase the historical question being asked.
A current source cannot automatically govern a historical event without checking commencement, amendments and transitional provisions.
A guidance document cannot override legislation.
Administrative practice cannot override an authoritative legal provision.
Case law must be tied to the proposition actually decided or reasoned.
Two documents are not contradictory merely because they describe different events or legal layers.
Different registration systems must not be conflated.
hard_stops: Never silently choose between conflicting property records.
Never treat an address/name collision as proof that two records concern the same property.
Never resolve a legal conflict merely by preferring the newer webpage.
Never use current law to silently rewrite historical legal effect.
Never suppress a material contradiction from the citizen-facing answer.
If a conflict affects the requested conclusion and cannot be resolved, do not publish a definitive answer.
